claims.claim: Industrial gear box and electric motor 20hp ratio 1:10
claims.evidence: Witness report describes a blue industrial motor/gearbox unit with an output shaft and a visible label, but the horsepower (20hp) and ratio (1:10) are not readable/confirmed in the provided observations.

risks.risk: Horsepower rating may not be 20hp (label not fully readable).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the nameplate showing horsepower/kW, voltage, frequency, and RPM.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used industrial motor/gearbox with unknown rating (worst-case: treat as not confirmed spec).

risks.risk: Gear ratio may not be 1:10 (gearbox ratio not shown).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the gearbox label/plate or any stamping showing the gear ratio (e.g., 1:10) and gearbox model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used gearbox with unknown ratio (worst-case: treat as not confirmed).

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (no test evidence; only scuffs/wear).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the unit running under load (or at least powered-on with stable operation), plus a sound/noise check and any oil leak check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until proven functional.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete components (coupling, starter/controller, mounting hardware) could reduce usability.
risks.proof: Photos showing what is included: coupling/shaft end details, any controller/starter, and all mounting hardware; also a shot of the full unit from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/without accessories unless the missing parts are shown.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the electrical nameplate with voltage (e.g., 380V/415V/220V), frequency (50Hz), and wiring diagram if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring verification for correct supply compatibility.

risks.risk: Exact model/serial number not confirmed (affects parts availability and authenticity).
risks.proof: A sharp, readable photo of the full nameplate including exact model and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown model for parts sourcing risk.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the nameplate showing horsepower/kW, voltage, frequency, and RPM.
Send a clear close-up of the gearbox plate showing gear ratio (e.g., 1:10) and gearbox model.
Provide a short video of the motor/gearbox running (powered-on) and show there are no unusual noises/vibration and no oil leaks.
Show what accessories are included: coupling/shaft end, any starter/controller, and all mounting hardware.
Send a sharp photo of the full nameplate with exact model number and serial number.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item as a used industrial motor/gearbox unit with an output shaft and visible branding, so it can be priced at its worst-case as an unverified-spec, untested used unit; the seller’s 20hp and 1:10 ratio claims are not confirmed by the report.
